art_note: Sophisticated high-end lifestyle staging that elevates the product to luxury standards.
desc_en: A silhouette crafted for absolute repose. Built from high-impact EVA foam, these clogs offer a cushioned texture that absorbs impact and provides exceptional support. The finish features a high-definition all-over print. Each pair includes an exclusive set of charms to customize the piece. Available made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta diseñada para el descanso absoluto. Confeccionados en espuma EVA de alto impacto, estos zuecos ofrecen una textura suave que absorbe los impactos y proporciona un soporte excepcional. El acabado presenta un estampado integral de alta definición. Cada par incluye un set de dijes exclusivos para personalizar la pieza. Disponibles bajo demanda con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· 100% high-impact EVA foam
· All-over print on exterior and strap
· Includes exclusive decorative charms
· Made to order
· Worldwide shipping
details_es:
